page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Printed line numbers (5, 10, 15 ... 35) stand in the left margin beside the column. Page number top right. Catchword "seu" at the lower right, signature "Cc" at the lower left. Left edge strip is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: vel voluntate & affectibus, invidendo proximis dona ipsorum; vel gestibus avaris, invidis & fallacibus; vel ser-mone fallente, aut tacente vitium in contractibus; vel ipsomet opere; vel captatione aut praebitione occasio-5num, quibus bona proximi mobilia vel immobilia da-mnum & vitium capiunt: sed, ut modis acquirendi legiti-mis studeamus, adeoque nostram rem augendo non di-minuamus rem proximi.

XXIX. Praeceptum nonum vult, ne dica-10mus falsum testimonium : vel iudicio sinistro[?], vel propensione malâ, vel gestib. ironicis, vel sermone mendace, vel actionibus fallacibus, vel occasionibus, simulationi & dissimulationi hypocriticae viam sternendo: sed studeamus veracitati, ut illâ vel eloquamur, vel celemus, 15prout gloria Dei, & salus publica & privata, animi & corporis, exigit.

XXX. Praeceptum decimum prohibet con-cupiscentiam inordinatam: hoc est, pravitatem co-20gitationum & cupiditatum, sive illae sint formatae sive in-formes, sive consensum eliciant sive non, sive sint moro-sae sive subitaneae; quae cum sint specie unę, non rectè hoc praeceptum à quibusdam in duo discerpitur. Caeterùm pravitati cogtationum & cupiditatum opponitur sanctitas ipsarum, & lucta adversus omnem impurum motum.

XXXI. Tertium caput Catechismi est O-ratio dominica, quae est compêdium sive sum-ma eorum, quae homini rectè credenti & viue-30tinunquam non sunt petenda à Deo. Praescriptū est hoc compendium à Christo, Matth.6.Luc.11.
XXXII. Eius partes sunt tres; praeparatio, sex petitiones, & confirmatio.
XXXIII. Praeparatio sive praefatio conti-35net tres causas impulsivas & exemplares pre-cationis. Nam quia Deus est Pater, affectu & effectu,

page.notes: Left edge strip (fragments of text at the far left of the scan) belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. "sinistro" first letter is uncertain (long s versus f). "cogtationum" and "Caeterùm" are printing errors as printed. "lucta" is uncertain (the letter after c is unclear). "viue-" and "tinunquam" are split at the line end; the hyphen is as printed. Line numbers 5 to 35 are printed line markers, not notes.
